issues.explanation: Ep5 shows Maya telling no one about Vanessa's blackmail, but Ep7 has Chloe claiming Maya told her and made her promise secrecy, so both cannot be true unless Maya told Chloe off-screen later.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Chloe's line so she found out on her own (e.g. she saw the texts on Maya's phone), or add a short scene where Maya confides in Chloe.
